text:
```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest

    - name: Update CDK version
      run: |
        sed -i 's/source-declarative-manifest:7.6.1/source-declarative-manifest:7.6.5/g' airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml
        sed -i 's/4.4.18/4.4.19/g' airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml

    - name: Add changelog entry
      run: echo "## 4.4.19" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md
      run: echo "- Updated CDK version to 7.6.5" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md

    - name: Commit changes
      run: git commit -am "Update CDK version from 7.6.1 to 7.6.5"

    - name: Push changes
      run: git push origin main
```
